changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.mail_settings ( id smallint NOT NULL, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, host varchar(255), port integer, security varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STARTTLS', username varchar(255), password_ciphertext text, from_address varchar(254), from_name varchar(90), reply_to_address varchar(254), last_update timestamp NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_mail_settings PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ck_administration_mail_settings_on_id CHECK (id = 1), CONSTRAINT ck_administration_mail_settings_on_port CHECK (port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), CONSTRAINT ck_administration_mail_settings_on_security CHECK (security IN ('NONE', 'STARTTLS', 'SSL_TLS')) );
